text: This staff report is regarding a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. In accordance with city-wide residential demolition control under the Toronto Municipal Code Ch.363, under the authority of Section 33 of the Planning Act, the application for the demolition of an existing mixed use building with commercial at grade and residential above is located at 1409 Gerrard St E (Application No. 20-172173 DEM) is being referred to the Toronto and East York Community Council for consideration to refuse or grant the application, including any conditions, if any, to be attached to the permit application because a building permit has not been issued for a replacement building.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Refused the application to demolish these buildings because there is no permit to replace the building on the site at 1409 Gerrard Street East at this time.
